verbatim_locators.evidence_for: Levothyroxine did not improve neurodevelopment in MCT8 deficiency
verbatim_locators.quote: Treatment with levothyroxine in a wide dose range (2.5–15 mcg/kg/day), commenced at the age of 0.5 to 36 months, did not improve neurodevelopment and, in some cases even aggravated the hyperthyroid state in peripheral tissues

verbatim_locators.evidence_for: Neurological efficacy of Triac unknown at the guideline date
verbatim_locators.quote: The neurocognitive response to TRIAC treatment is unknown (123, 124), and is currently under investigation (NCT02396459).
No available treatment regimen has proven to rescue the neurocognitive phenotype in humans with MCT8 deficiency.
